solution.what: Grepped Tomokiyo's AGS Estado page (spanish2C_now.htm) for R9963 and Cifuentes.
Fetched the 6 DECODE images with the shared cookie.
Viewed every page: image 5 (f. 54r) is a decipherment in a secretary's hand; f. 53r has a marginal gloss of the struck first cipher line.

The decipherment keeps the letter's clear islands ('y en este proposito me dixo que havia un mes que le', 'Tambien') at the matching places; the same cipher run stands for 'dixo el embax[ador]' in both passages.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): entry with summary; no transcription and no decryption in the repository (the bound contemporary decipherment f. 54r is on the DECODE images only; project work).

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): no text of R9963 is in the repository beyond fragments quoted in NOTES. Relabelled decoded, not read; class already solved -> not read; method read from existing decipherment -> not solved, until f. 54 is transcribed.

Re-read brief b25: all six DECODE images opened; the decipherment is record image 6 (file _005), image 5 its faint verso. f. 54r decipherment transcribed line by line (texts/f54_decipherment.txt) and the letter's clear text from images 2 and 4.

Decipherment checked against the cipher letter: clear islands at the same places; the clear numeral xviij at the end of a f. 53r cipher line carries the decipherment's '[?e] viij meses'; the run 'q L 20 4 m b' repeats where the decipherment repeats 'embaxador'. No sign-by-sign decode (no key in the repository).

texts.label: Count of Cifuentes, Rome, to Charles V, 3 Sep 1534
texts.summary: The imperial ambassador in Rome reports Clement VII's last illness (the doctors hold little hope for his life); Ercole II of Ferrara presses through Cifuentes for his investiture before the Pope dies, the French ambassador offers to settle Ferrara with Charles, the Landgrave of Hesse and the Duke of Saxony are said to be treating with Francis I, and there is news of Nassau going to Flanders. Deciphered at the time: the decipherment is bound with the letter as f. 54r (DECODE image 5).

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b25): the letter's clear text and the contemporary decipherment bound as f. 54r (DECODE record image 6, file _005), transcribed from the images for the first time; the decipherment's clear islands, the clear numeral xviij and a repeated cipher run checked against the letter; no sign-by-sign decode (no key in the repository). No word supplied. Body 0.756 clean sentences (31/41), explicit holes 1.00; unclean sentences are period spellings and names.
